action_items.task: Update the reconciliation job to read the dedupe key
Write the ADR for the idempotent retries decision
Own the rollout plan (web client first, then mobile client in the release after next)
Write the stakeholder update telling the support team that duplicate charges will stop after the mobile release

decisions.decision: Adopt idempotent retries with a client dedupe key (Option A); do not build the server dedupe table
decisions.rationale: Option B would block two legitimate payments of the same amount within the window, and the gateway already supports an idempotency key header so only clients need to send it

summary.summary: Architecture review on idempotent retries for payment requests. The team chose Option A (client-side dedupe key) over Option B (server-side dedupe table) to avoid blocking legitimate duplicate-amount payments. Rollout will start with the web client, followed by the mobile client in the next release. Jun will write the ADR by Wednesday, Theo will update the reconciliation job, Mira will own the rollout plan, and Me will write the stakeholder update to the support team.
